about: Total Telcom Inc., through its subsidiary, ROM Communications Inc., develops and provides remote asset monitoring and tracking products and services in the United States and Canada. It offers Water-TraX, a self-contained certified satellite device for remote satellite water monitoring; ROM Controllers, which is used in trucking, forestry, industrial, construction, and RV markets; SATrv, a satellite-based telematics system for the recreational vehicle marketplace; RacingTraX, a purpose-built off-road racing device and management system; and DataTraX that is used in forestry applications managing resources and inventory. The company also provides ROMTraX, a satellite device; TextAnywhere, a stand-alone satellite messaging device; StormWatch, a global satellite RTU used in environmental applications for water, air and soil monitoring, remote weather stations; AlarmTraX, which is used to monitor private and commercial power generators, solar power installations, and water levels in production and agriculture; and SiteTraX, a self-contained remote location management system. In addition, it offers CamTraX, a self-contained satellite camera used to take and send pictures, as well as record video to monitor changes in remote locations from erosion, flooding, spills, and leaks. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Kelowna, Canada.
